1442121.sourceDescription:
## Features
- Connectable LED cluster lights up to 100m
- Warm, cool, gold or RGB colour options
- Durable waterproof cable for indoor and outdoor use

## Information
Transform your home, garden, or event space with our premium LED Cluster Lights, designed to bring a magical glow both indoors and outdoors. Part of our versatile mains voltage system, these fairy cluster lights are crafted to deliver maximum brightness with energy efficient and long-lasting LED bulbs. Perfect for festive displays, weddings, parties, or year-round decoration, they provide an enchanting atmosphere wherever they are used. The unique clustered design creates a dense garland of lights, ensuring a vibrant and eye-catching display. With easy-to-connect plugs, you can join multiple 5m lengths together to achieve the exact coverage you need, up to a maximum of 100m. Available in warm white, cool white, copper gold, or RGB colour changing options, you can choose the ideal tone to match your mood or occasion. Built with durable rubber cable and waterproof ends, these lights are suitable for outdoor use in all weather conditions, while being equally at home indoors. Attach them to porches, fences, gutters, gates, or drape them across mantels and Christmas trees for a versatile and professional-quality finish. Simple to install and reliable in performance, these connectable cluster lights are the perfect way to illuminate your surroundings with elegance and style. Whether you want to highlight a small corner or create a grand display across larger areas, these LED cluster lights offer flexibility, durability, and a timeless glow that will brighten any space season after season.

8209021.sourceDescription:
## Features
- Perfect for any home or garden this festive season
- 1000 LEDs in rainbow colours
- 8 hours on and 16 hours off timer function
- Multi-function light display

## Information
Brighten up your home this Christmas with these mains operated multi-function TreeBrights by Premier Decorations. The lights are on a clear string, enabling them to easily blend into almost any setting, spaced approximately 2.5cm apart. Switch through the 8 available functions by the press of a dual-purpose button on the transformer, 5m lead from the plug to the first bulb. The button can be held in to activate and deactivate the 8 hours on and 16 hours off timer function, the timer is active when the button is illuminated. Available functions are static, combination, in waves, sequential, slow glow, chasing flash, slow fade and twinkle flash. Suitable for both indoor and outdoor use. Not just for Christmas, this set can be used at any point of the year and in a variety of ways, ideal for providing ambient lighting and creating eye-catching scenes.
